overview.description: These settings apply to this server. Use the menu at the bottom to manage other features.

announcement.overviewDescription: Choose an announcement type below to manage where it posts and customize its settings.

announcement.categoriesDescription: Choose All to ping on every daily post. Choose specific categories to ping only when a matching event ends within 24 hours.
announcement.everyoneUnavailable: Choose a server role other than @everyone.
